conversation_context.summary_zh: 前文是PrometeusCT的每周财报串，重点讨论AI基础设施带动Cisco、Applied Materials等公司业绩及增长可持续性。收录帖转到主品牌，称以旧换新补贴减弱导致营收下降，但利润率、现金流提升并被公司称为“转折点”。后续补充市场更关注增长持续性。该语境显示这是财报解读，非消费体验投诉，情绪偏中性谨慎。

posts.translation_zh:
#Economic_Calendar #Earnings

📍8月10日至16日每周财报摘要

📍🧵👇见评论区 https://t.co/frxMwnoMsq

posts.text: 📝AI infrastructure demand dominated last week’s earnings, lifting even non-tech companies, but several firms flagged that growth is starting to normalize — and markets reacted cautiously despite strong headline numbers.
posts.original_text: 📝AI infrastructure demand dominated last week’s earnings, lifting even non-tech companies, but several firms flagged that growth is starting to normalize — and markets reacted cautiously despite strong headline numbers.
posts.translation_zh: 📝AI 基础设施需求主导了上周的财报，甚至提振了非科技公司，但有几家公司提示增长正开始常态化——尽管总体数据强劲，市场反应仍然谨慎。

posts.text:
📊Highlights

•Cisco — Record results; targeting $7.5B in AI infrastructure revenue next year (nearly 2x this year), citing a “multi-year networking super cycle.” Cloud giant orders up ~4.5x YoY. But gross margins are eroding due to pricier memory chips and hardware mix.
posts.original_text:
📊Highlights

•Cisco — Record results; targeting $7.5B in AI infrastructure revenue next year (nearly 2x this year), citing a “multi-year networking super cycle.” Cloud giant orders up ~4.5x YoY. But gross margins are eroding due to pricier memory chips and hardware mix.
posts.translation_zh:
📊亮点

•Cisco — 业绩创纪录；目标是明年 AI 基础设施收入达到 $7.5B（接近今年的 2 倍），并称其为“多年期网络超级周期”。云计算巨头订单同比增长约 4.5 倍。但由于更昂贵的内存芯片和硬件组合，毛利率正在被侵蚀。

posts.text: •Applied Materials — Record revenue, strongest-ever sequential growth; landed Broadcom as a new partner; plans to double factory output by 2028.
posts.original_text: •Applied Materials — Record revenue, strongest-ever sequential growth; landed Broadcom as a new partner; plans to double factory output by 2028.
posts.translation_zh: •Applied Materials — 收入创纪录，环比增速为史上最强；将 Broadcom 纳入为新合作伙伴；计划到 2028 年将工厂产量翻倍。

posts.text: •Super Micro — Guided to $65–72B revenue next year on $60B in fresh orders; margin doubled, but ~75% of the beat came from one-off/timing gains, not core business.
posts.original_text: •Super Micro — Guided to $65–72B revenue next year on $60B in fresh orders; margin doubled, but ~75% of the beat came from one-off/timing gains, not core business.
posts.translation_zh: •Super Micro — 指引明年收入为 $65–72B，新增订单达 $60B；利润率翻倍，但超预期部分中约 75% 来自一次性/时间性收益，而非核心业务。

posts.text: •Aramark — Unexpected AI beneficiary: now feeding workers at hyperscaler data centers, becoming a growing business line.
posts.original_text: •Aramark — Unexpected AI beneficiary: now feeding workers at hyperscaler data centers, becoming a growing business line.
posts.translation_zh: •Aramark — 意外成为 AI 受益者：现在为超大规模数据中心的工作人员提供餐饮服务，正成为一条增长中的业务线。

posts.text: •Venture Global (natural gas) — Raised profit outlook for 3rd straight quarter, hiked dividend 122%, locked in 91% of output under contract — driven by data-center electricity demand.
posts.original_text: •Venture Global (natural gas) — Raised profit outlook for 3rd straight quarter, hiked dividend 122%, locked in 91% of output under contract — driven by data-center electricity demand.
posts.translation_zh: •Venture Global（天然气）——连续第三个季度上调利润展望，将股息提高122%，并通过合同锁定了91%的产量——受数据中心用电需求推动。

posts.text: •Cardinal Health — Strong year, but guided to slower drug-distribution growth and lighter cash flow; flagged a one-time tariff refund inflated recent results.
posts.original_text: •Cardinal Health — Strong year, but guided to slower drug-distribution growth and lighter cash flow; flagged a one-time tariff refund inflated recent results.
posts.translation_zh: •Cardinal Health——全年表现强劲，但指引显示药品分销增长将放缓、现金流将减弱；并指出一次性关税退款抬高了近期业绩。

posts.text: •https://t.co/z81ZwDrCJo — Revenue shrank as trade-in subsidies faded, but profit, margins, and cash flow all surged; company calls it a “turning point.”
posts.original_text: •https://t.co/z81ZwDrCJo — Revenue shrank as trade-in subsidies faded, but profit, margins, and cash flow all surged; company calls it a “turning point.”
posts.translation_zh: •https://t.co/z81ZwDrCJo ——随着以旧换新补贴消退，营收萎缩，但利润、利润率和现金流均大幅增长；公司称这是一个“转折点”。

posts.text: •Market reaction — Despite upbeat results, shares of Cisco, Applied Materials, https://t.co/z81ZwDrCJo, Performance Food Group, and Amcor all fell — investors focusing on sustainability of growth, not past performance.
posts.original_text: •Market reaction — Despite upbeat results, shares of Cisco, Applied Materials, https://t.co/z81ZwDrCJo, Performance Food Group, and Amcor all fell — investors focusing on sustainability of growth, not past performance.

lead_post.text:
Joybuy is the newly launched European online retail brand owned by the Chinese e-commerce giant JD. Officially introduced in March 2026, it serves as a direct competitor to major platforms like Amazon, Bol etc. 
I looked at the prices for Korean and Japanese products, and it’s extremely interesting.
For example, this sauce €5, usually sold elsewhere between 20 and 25 euros. Korean Soju alcohol at 3€ etc.

featured_items.original_text:
Joybuy is the newly launched European online retail brand owned by the Chinese e-commerce giant JD. Officially introduced in March 2026, it serves as a direct competitor to major platforms like Amazon, Bol etc. 
I looked at the prices for Korean and Japanese products, and it’s extremely interesting.
For example, this sauce €5, usually sold elsewhere between 20 and 25 euros. Korean Soju alcohol at 3€ etc.
featured_items.translation_zh:
Joybuy 是中国电商巨头 JD 新推出的欧洲在线零售品牌。它于 2026 年 3 月正式推出，是 Amazon、Bol 等主要平台的直接竞争对手。
我看了韩国和日本产品的价格，非常有意思。
例如，这款酱料 €5，在其他地方通常卖 20 到 25 欧元。韩国 Soju 酒 3€ 等等。

top_posts.text:
"Brands are losing 3-10% of their top-line revenue to counterfeiters, dupes, and unauthorized resellers."

 @oliverbrocato, Founder of Bustem, says "Even David Protein has 12 one-to-one clones of their website."

"When you start making money online, people bite at your heels to take a piece." 

"It's worse in ecommerce because there are basically zero barriers to entry. Anyone can screenshot your product image and rip you off." 

It shows up in a dozen ways:

- Counterfeit one-to-one dupes from Temu, Alibaba, etc.

- Unauthorized resellers on Amazon, eBay, Walmart. Sometimes selling right on your own ASIN, so the customer thinks they're buying from you.

- Full clones of your website.

- Keyword ad hijacking. Bad actors run ads on the real brand's name and rank #1-5, siphoning off traffic that should've been yours.

- Ripped Meta ads run against you. Since Meta is an auction, that drives your own CPMs up.

The Bustem fix is a blend of software, scrapers, AI agents, and automation.

Backed by a team of human analysts who hunt down the bad actors and get them removed.

All without hiring a lawyer and spending six figures and three years in court.

@ecommcowboy is live M-F at 12P CT.

top_posts.translation_zh:
“品牌正因造假者、仿品和未经授权的转售商损失其总收入的 3-10%。”

 Bustem 创始人 @oliverbrocato 表示：“甚至 David Protein 的网站都有 12 个一比一克隆版。”

“当你开始在网上赚钱时，就会有人紧咬着你，想分一杯羹。”

“在电商领域情况更糟，因为基本上没有进入门槛。任何人都可以截取你的产品图片，然后抄袭你。”

它会以十几种方式出现：

- 来自 Temu、Alibaba 等的一比一假冒仿品。

- Amazon、eBay、Walmart 上未经授权的转售商。有时甚至直接在你自己的 ASIN 上销售，让顾客以为他们是在向你购买。

- 你网站的完整克隆版。

- 关键词广告劫持。不良行为者用真实品牌的名称投放广告，并排在第 1-5 位， siphon 走本该属于你的流量。

- 被盗用的 Meta 广告反过来与你竞争。由于 Meta 是拍卖机制，这会推高你自己的 CPM。

Bustem 的解决方案是软件、爬虫、AI 代理和自动化的组合。

并由一支人工分析师团队支持，他们会追查不良行为者并将其移除。

这一切都无需聘请律师，也无需花六位数金额和三年时间打官司。

@ecommcowboy 周一至周五 CT 时间 12P 直播。

top_posts.text:
@buggy_robot @ariaradnia How is $UBER or $FICO a value trap?

UBER has an ecosystem that would take trillions to replicate their scale and they are transitioning into autonomy. It’s not a winner take all scenario, it never is. By your logic, Amazon should have went bankrupt because Alibaba, Temu and Shopify exist and have competitive pricing.

FICO has a federally regualted moat still. I don’t see how it’s a value trap. 

APP could be a value trap if the Apple ecosystem changes how data is shared with third party networks, but I don’t see that happening. But it’s a more realistic bear case than Uber being disrupted or FICO .

top_posts.translation_zh:
@buggy_robot @ariaradnia $UBER 或 $FICO 怎么会是价值陷阱？

UBER 拥有一个生态系统，要复制他们的规模需要花费数万亿美元，而且他们正在向自动驾驶转型。这不是赢者通吃的局面，从来都不是。按你的逻辑，Amazon 本该破产，因为 Alibaba、Temu 和 Shopify 都存在，而且价格有竞争力。

FICO 仍然有一个受联邦监管的护城河。我不明白它怎么会是价值陷阱。

如果 Apple 生态系统改变与第三方网络共享数据的方式，APP 可能会成为价值陷阱，但我不认为这种事会发生。不过相比 Uber 被颠覆或 FICO，这个看空理由更现实。
